person_note: Jazz Bashara is the participating first-person base narrator. Numerous event passages and narratorial beats independently expose her actions, perceptions, and reactions as “I,” including interior scenes well beyond the opening. The authorized first-chapter extract agrees, while the publisher’s author interview and multiple opened whole-book sources explicitly describe Jazz’s first-person narration. The book also intersperses Jazz/Kelvin emails; these are local embedded documents, as illustrated by q01915 and the authorized extract, and do not create a sustained base section in another grammatical person. The only material limitation is that the authorized prose source covers the opening, but the distributed quote evidence and explicit whole-book sources resolve that scope limitation without credible contrary evidence.
